Search alarms across the organization with filters for site, alarm group, severity, type, acknowledgement state, acknowledgement admin, and time range.

query.description: Filter results by site identifier. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

Alarm group used to filter alarm results. enum: `certificate_expiry`, `infrastructure`, `marvis`, `security`. The `marvis` group is used to retrieve AI-driven network issue detections. Known Marvis alarm types include: `bad_cable`, `bad_wan_uplink`, `dns_failure`, `arp_failure`, `auth_failure`, `dhcp_failure`, `missing_vlan`, `negotiation_mismatch`, `port_flap`. Results include resolution status (`status`, `resolved_time`) and affected entity details. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.
Alarm severity used to filter results. enum: `critical`, `info`, `warn`. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.
Filter alarms by alarm type. Accepts multiple values separated by comma. Use [List Alarm Definitions](/#operations/listAlarmDefinitions) to get the list of possible alarm types
Name of the admins who have acked the alarms; accepts multiple values separated by comma
Filter alarm results by whether the alarm has been acknowledged
Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`
Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`
Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`
Maximum number of results to return per page
On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order
Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.
